summary: Reconcile main 712ba9d and issue state into a minimal next-action package. The 100-pair coordinator and fake-only tests are merged, but production UI/CLI wiring and host-lifetime compatibility remain mandatory before hardware 100/100. Preserve the one-shot -> 10 -> measured-p95 approval -> 100 chain and keep A0 quality, rig, corpus, packaging, and Post-MVP work separate.
non_completion_guards: CaptureRecoveryOnly captures and verifies both originals but never stitches; it must report StitchOutcome Pending and A0 quality Unapproved
a passing one-shot or ten-pair run does not authorize the 100-pair run until the measured p95 is explicitly approved
a failed one-shot, characterization pair, durability pair, or fault transaction stops that stage and must not be replaced by retry
physical USB disconnect, power, or card actions remain operator-gated and are not implied by software fault tests
CaptureRecoveryOnly evidence does not prove approved-rig behavior, stitching, A0 output quality, packaging, release, or shutter synchronization
CI and local software validation do not establish hardware acceptance. Any billing/quota block encountered must be recorded as environment-blocked, not Pass.
no camera serial, SDK archive or licensed binary, credential, customer original, captured image, or non-redacted hardware identity may be committed
The implemented 10-pair runner has no established Dual hardware acceptance; the merged internal 100-pair coordinator remains deliberately unwired and is not a production runner.
The 600-second default is a server/request lifetime budget, not a guaranteed process-exit deadline; cleanup may exceed it and hardware-run compatibility is not established.

This synchronization does not run hardware, close human decisions, promote completion, reprioritize work, or authorize release. PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md:35-39 remains a pinned pre-synchronization note outside this six-file scope.
